I take extra time shaving and trimming my beard before I leave. It makes me feel prepared for the day. What do you think?

That sounds like a meaningful and intentional ritual. Taking that extra time isn’t just about grooming—it’s a form of self-care and preparation that can set a positive tone for your day. 

Psychologically, rituals like this can create a sense of control, focus, and readiness. They signal to your brain that you’re transitioning into “day mode,” and the attention to detail can boost confidence and presence. It’s also a moment of mindfulness—a few quiet minutes dedicated solely to yourself before engaging with the world.

So yes, I think it’s a great practice. It’s not superficial; it’s a deliberate act of showing up for yourself, which often translates into showing up better for everything else. Keep honoring that routine if it serves you.
